guitar.notes: Accurate: Paul Simon long associated with Martin and Guild acoustics.

tone.summary: The rig simulates a dry acoustic sound using the cleanest available amp/cab combination (US Deluxe/US 2x12) with minimal effects to capture the fingerpicked, vintage folk feel of Simon & Garfunkel.

rig.name: Simon & Garfunkel - Scarborough Fair - Valeton GP-180
